content.scenario: A customer buys a smartphone that stops working within a week of purchase. The customer can seek a refund as the goods are defective and the consideration has been paid.
content.outcome: The customer is entitled to a refund of the full amount paid for the smartphone within the stipulated period, and the seller is required to provide a refund or replace the defective product.
